FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 2 : A group representing nearly all major automakers on Monday urged US lawmakers to pass a permanent ban on Chinese vehicles when they return next week for a quick session after the midterm congressional elections. In September, the Senate sponsors of the bipartisan effort to ban Chinese vehicles agreed to delay an effort to fast-track the measure until November. "We need to protect the U.S. market from a flood of Chinese imports that carry surveillance risk and disadvantage current manufacturers that have made generational investments in American communities," said John Bozzella, who heads the Alliance for Automotive Innovation, which represents General Motors, Toyota, Volkswagen and other major automakers.

Source: Reuters

Nov 2 : South Africa batting coach Ashwell Prince and wicketkeeper Kyle Verreynne have been reprimanded by the International Cricket Council for showing dissent towards the umpires on the third day of the third test against Australia at Newlands. • South Africa batter Marques Ackerman attempted to review a caught decision but was told by umpires Richard Illingworth and Richard Kettleborough that he was past the stipulated 15 seconds to do so. • Prince was seen shouting at the umpires that Ackerman had signalled he would review within the time allowed. • Verreynne, who was not playing in the match but had 12th man duties, told Ackerman to remain on the field of play, delaying his exit.

If a player or official reaches for demerit points in a 24-month period, they face suspension. • South Africa won the match by 176 runs to claim the series 2-1 and move to the top of the world test rankings.

item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した９月の建設支出（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１．９％減少...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米建設支出、9月は前月比1.9％減　材料費高で住宅改修が低迷 1:34 配信

2026年8月6日、米国カリフォルニア州サンディエゴで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake　（ロイター） [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した９月の建設支出（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１．９％減少した。上方修正された前月の大幅な伸びをほぼ打ち消した。材料費の高騰が住宅改修への支出を押し下げたとみられる。 ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．３％増だった。

８月は当初発表の０．９％増から２．０％増に上方修正された。

９月は前年同月比では２．７％減少した。

９月の民間部門の建設支出は８月の２．６％増から一転し、２．４％減少した。

住宅建設向け投資は５．５％急減した。改修の低迷を反映したとみられる。一戸建て住宅向けの支出は横ばいだったが、前年同月比では２．４％減少した。

住宅投資は第３・四半期に再び縮小に転じた。住宅ローン金利の上昇が背景にある。住宅金融会社フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローンの平均金利は、対イラン戦争が始まった２月下旬以降、少なくとも１２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇した。

集合住宅向けの支出は９月に０．１％増加した。

民間非住宅建設への投資は９月に１．１％増加し、発電所向けの支出は１．２％増加した。

公共部門の建設投資は、８月の０．２％増から一転し、０．１％減となった。州・地方政府の建設支出は０．３％減少したが、連邦政府のプロジェクト向け支出は２．５％急増した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 11/3(火) 1:34 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

PARIS, Nov 2 : Violette Dorange is facing the first major setback of her young sailing career as she risks a complaint following a collision with Romain Pilliard in the 13th Route du Rhum. The contact between the 25-year-old sailor, who became the youngest competitor to finish the Vendee Globe in 2025, and Pilliard occurred on Sunday, shortly after the start from Saint-Malo, northwestern France of the transatlantic race to Pointe-a-Pitre in Guadeloupe. "I’ve informed the race committee that I’m going to lodge a complaint against Initiatives Coeur," Pilliard told French sports daily L'Equipe. "She's a great sailor, I don't blame her. I know her and I like her a lot, but it's a mistake."

Both boats headed for Roscoff to assess the damage, with Dorange's Initiatives-Coeur IMOCA suffering issues affecting its foil and hull. "I'm still in the race but it's on standby; there is major damage to my boat, it's broken," Pilliard said in an Instagram video. Dorange will sail to her home port Lorient to repair the monohull, Initiatives-Coeur said in a statement. "It's a racing incident, the kind that sometimes happens," Dorange said. "Romain had to make a manoeuvre that put Use It Again in front of Initiatives-Cœur's path. I didn't have enough time to adjust my settings and avoid the collision." "The impact was violent. In this condition, it's impossible to cross the Atlantic. It's a huge disappointment. I'm also thinking of Romain and his team," she added. Ronan Deshayes, Initiatives-Coeur technical director, also told L'Equipe that the team had lodged a complaint. Dorange joined Initiatives-Coeur last year, spending her first season alongside Britain's Samantha Davies before switching to solo in 2026. She claimed two podium finishes during this year's IMOCA season.

Source: Reuters

item.title: フーシ派、イエメン暫定首都アデンの80キロ地点まで進軍＝関係筋
item.description: [２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は、同国暫定政府の事実上の首都アデンから８０キロの地点まで進軍したと、４人の軍事筋が２日、ロイターに明らかにした。

フーシ派と政府軍は２日、アデンへの主要な進入路の一つであるトゥール・アルバハ地区の入り口にある軍事キャンプで戦闘を継続している。

情報筋によると、フーシ派は３日前にアルマカティラにある政府軍陣地への攻撃を開始し、以来、同地区全体を掌握したという。この山岳地帯はタイズとアデンを結ぶ道路を見下ろす場所にあり、フーシ派は政府軍をトゥール・アルバハ方面へ撤退させたという。

イエメンの情報相は、コメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

今回の進軍により、フーシ派は２０１５年の戦争初期以来、最もアデンに接近したことになる。今回の攻勢により、米国・イスラエルによる対イラン戦争における不安定な新たな戦線が開かれ、フーシ派とサウジアラビアの双方がこの地域紛争にさらに深く巻き込まれている。

item.title: South Korean president's passport details leaked online, broadcaster reports
item.description: SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's passport details and those of some of his staff were leaked online in a file posted in June on a paid website, the South Korean broadcaster KBS reported on Monday (Nov 2).

FAST

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's passport details and those of some of his staff were leaked online in a file posted in June on a paid website, the South Korean broadcaster KBS reported on Monday (Nov 2). The passport information of 168 people including Lee, his security officers and National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac was posted on the website in early June, the report said. KBS said it had informed the presidential Blue House after becoming aware of the leak. The office said it was looking into the matter and intended to take immediate action, according to the report. The file was posted under the name "passenger list" days before Lee's trip to Europe earlier this year, it added. Lee travelled to Belgium and Italy in June, and also to France for a Group of Seven leaders' summit . It was unclear how the confidential file was uploaded or who downloaded it, the report said.

item.title: ベルギー首相が辞意表明、予算巡る膠着状態打開ならず 国王は判断保留
item.description:
Bart H. Meijer
[ブリュッセル ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bart H. Meijer

[ブリュッセル ２日 ロイター] - ベルギーのデウェーフェル首相は２日、連立与党が来年の予算を巡る膠着状態を打開できなかったとして、フィリップ国王に辞意を伝えた。王宮によると、国王はデウェーフェル氏の辞意の受理を保留し、３日からは他の連立与党の党首らとも協議を行う予定だという。

ベルギー政権は、財政安定に向けて必要だとデウェーフェル氏が主張する１００億ユーロ（１１２億ドル）規模の歳出削減と増税を巡り、数カ月にわたって議論を続けてきた。

しかし、数カ月に及ぶ協議の中で、デウェーフェル氏が率いる中道右派「新フランデレン同盟（Ｎ－ＶＡ）」とリベラル派「改革運動（ＭＲ）」は、社会主義系および中道系の連立パートナー各党と歩み寄ることができなかった。

王宮は「地政学的な不確実性が極めて大きく、深刻な経済的課題を抱える中、同国は長期の政治危機を許容することはできない」と述べた。

Nov 2 : Russian owners of non-state data centres will be required to reserve 10 per cent of their capacity to help keep Russia's IT infrastructure running, according to a decree signed by President Vladimir Putin on Monday. This mechanism would allow Russian authorities to quickly access available data centre capacity if needed. Russian data centres have become targets of Ukrainian drone attacks in recent weeks, with facilities operated by technology companies Yandex and Sberbank struck in October. Putin instructed the Digital Development Ministry to conduct an inventory of available capacity and floor space at privately owned data centres across Russia.

The decree also allows for the temporary use of data centres located abroad, subject to approval by the FSB security service.

2026年10月26日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）　REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター］ - ２日序盤の米国株式市場は、ダウ工業株３０種が一時５００ドル超、ナスダック総合が一時２００ポイント超上昇するなど、大幅高となっている。株価指数先物も上げ幅を拡大した。

イラン戦争の終結に向けたイランとカタール当局者の協議を受けて中東の供給混乱が緩和するとの期待が高まり、米原油価格が６％近く急落したことが背景にある。

イラン外務省は、米国との紛争終結に向けた接触が続いていると明らかにした。

ハイテク大手も上昇。アマゾン・ドット・コムが３．９％高、グーグルの親会社である米アルファベットが２．２％高となった。人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの第３・四半期決算で純損失が大幅に縮小し、売上高が急増したことを好感した。

United's Carrick brushes off questions over his future ahead of Roma clash

FAST

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 2 : Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has brushed aside questions about his long-term future, saying his focus remained firmly on Tuesday's home Champions League clash with AS Roma as his side look to end a nine-match winless run. United are 17th in the Premier League with seven points from nine games, above the relegation zone on goal difference, and are enduring their longest winless streak since 1984. The United board has nevertheless opted to stick with their former midfielder Carrick despite the run of poor results, including defeats by Como, Bournemouth and Chelsea. Asked about his future, Carrick told a press conference: "That has no influence on how we prepare or on the game tomorrow.

"We cannot wait for the game tomorrow. That is all I am focused on. What happens after, happens. Whatever direction it goes in ... "I love being here, I love working with the players. The struggles, the challenges, that just drives you on to want even more." The pressure on United is heightened by their position in the Champions League standings, where they sit 21st with three points from three matches. Roma are 15th with four points. "We know what we are capable of. We are close but need to act on it quickly," Carrick said. "We have two great games this week (at home to Roma and Aston Villa in the Premier League on Sunday). A great opportunity to attack the game and make it a good night." Carrick also said he had no concerns about centre back Lisandro Martinez's commitment following the 28-year-old Argentine's dismissal in the 2-0 defeat at Chelsea. "Things happen in football. Sometimes you make mistakes. The commitment is not an issue," he added. Carrick's defence of Martinez comes against a backdrop of growing scrutiny on the club, with frustrations spilling into the open in recent weeks. Last month, captain Bruno Fernandes questioned tactics after the 4-1 thrashing at Como, while Martinez criticised the club hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat away to Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level. But Carrick added that the squad remained united. "The dressing room is a good place," he said. "Perception is a funny thing. You can make things look different ways and think about all sorts of different things. "The commitment of the players to the club, to me, to each other - do not question at all. We need to play better, we can make better decisions but the commitment is not a thing at all."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 足元の金融安定リスク、ＡＩ株の割高評価・債券・影の銀行＝ＥＣＢ副総裁
item.description: [フランクフルト ２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁は２日、現時点での金融安定にとっての主...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
足元の金融安定リスク、ＡＩ株の割高評価・債券・影の銀行＝ＥＣＢ副総裁 0:12 配信

ドイツ・フランクフルトにかる欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）本部。２０２４年６月撮影。REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁は２日、現時点での金融安定にとっての主なリスクとして、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の高いバリュエーション、債券市場のストレス、「シャドーバンキング（影の銀行）」による潜在的な損失を挙げた。

ＥＣＢが半期に１度の金融安定報告書の発表を１１月１８日に控える中、ＡＩ投資の期待リターンが精査される中で市場は不安定化し、フランスなど債務を抱える国は圧力に直面している。

ブイチッチ氏はアイルランドで開催されたイベントで「金融安定報告書の策定中に、ＡＩ関連銘柄の調整局面が見られた」と指摘。多くの投資ファンドがＡＩに関連するポジションを保有していることに言及し、「明らかに、欧州を含め誰もがその影響を受けている」と述べた。

第２のリスクとしてブイチッチ氏は、特に債務を抱える国々における足元の国債利回りの急上昇を挙げた。ＥＣＢは債券市場を「注視する」としつつも、ＥＣＢの公式見解を踏まえ、介入に関する臆測を打ち消す形で、まず対応すべきは各国政府だとし、「問題が財政にあるのなら、第一に財政面での対応でなければならない」と述べた。

さらに、３つ目の主なリスクとして、投資ファンドやその他のシャドーバンク（非銀行系金融機関）における損失を挙げた。

item.title: アンソロピック、第3四半期は赤字が大幅縮小 売上高は急増
item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの第３・四半期決算（９月３０日まで）は、純損失が大幅に縮小...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック、第3四半期は赤字が大幅縮小　売上高は急増 0:08 配信

2026年10月26日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [２日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの第３・四半期決算（９月３０日まで）は、純損失が大幅に縮小し、売上高が急増した。２日に米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出された新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請の修正書類で明らかになった。

第３・四半期の純損失は２３２億９０００万ドルと、第２・四半期の６６３億ドルから縮小した。売上高は１１５億６０００万ドルから１６９億６０００万ドルに増加した。

営業損益は５億６７００万ドルの赤字となり、第２・四半期の９億７４００万ドルの黒字から赤字に転落した。

アマゾン・ドット・コムやアルファベット傘下のグーグルなど、提携先とのコンピューティング関連契約に伴う支出コミットメントは約８９５４億ドルに上った。ＡＩインフラ関連としては過去最大級となる。

アンソロピックは先週、株式上場を申請した。投資家が巨額のＡＩインフラ投資に注目する中、同社のＩＰＯは、ＡＩ企業に対する投資意欲を測る重要な試金石と見られている。

item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が２日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月ＩＳＭ製造業景気指数、55.5へ上昇　投入コスト高止まり 0:04 配信

鋼材を溶接する自動溶接機。米イリノイ州メンドータにある工場で２０２５年２月撮影。REUTERS/Vincent Alban（ロイター） [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が２日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は５５．５と、９月の５４．５から上昇した。堅調な内需を背景に拡大ペースが加速した。一方で原材料などの仕入れ価格は高止まりした。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は５４．６への小幅上昇だった。ＰＭＩは今年、拡大と縮小の境目となる５０を上回って推移しており、製造業が拡大していることを示している。

新規受注指数は５５．５と、９月の５５．３からやや上昇し、輸出も増えた。製造業の在庫も増加した。

ただ、供給業者は旺盛な需要への対応に苦慮している。入荷遅延指数は５９．１と、９月の５９．０からわずかに上昇した。５０を上回ると納入の遅れを示す。このため原材料などの仕入れコストは引き続き上昇した。

仕入れ価格指数は９月の７７．９から７５．２に低下したものの、依然として高水準にある。エコノミストは７７．０への低下を予想していた。

雇用指数は５２．４と引き続き５０を上回ったが、９月の５２．７から小幅に低下した。

Seven migrants die in seas off Spain’s Canary Islands

Reuters

02 November, 2026 08:30 pm IST

MADRID, Nov 2 (Reuters) – At least seven migrants died off Spain’s Canary Islands while more than 380 people were rescued on Monday, the country’s maritime rescue services said.

Two deceased people were found aboard a migrant boat when the coast guard rescued 132 people on Monday, 150 km (94 miles) off Lanzarote. During the same journey, five other migrants had died and been thrown into the sea, authorities added.

Another 250 migrants were rescued by coast guard boats off Lanzarote and the Canary Island of El Hierro earlier on Monday, authorities said. On Sunday, 107 migrants were rescued off El Hierro, according to authorities.

Show Full Article

“The worst forecasts are coming true. The Atlantic route is once again claiming lives, this time off the coast of Lanzarote. Behind each one is a life, a story, and a family,” Canary Islands President Fernando Clavijo said in a message on X.

The Atlantic route from West Africa to the Canary Islands is one of the world’s deadliest migration crossings. Thousands of migrants attempt the journey each year in overcrowded boats, seeking to reach Spanish territory despite rough seas, strong currents and long distances.

Arrivals tend to pick up in the autumn months, when sea conditions along the route are generally calmer and more favorable for crossings.

Migrant arrivals have declined so far this year compared with the same period in 2025, but crossings increased sharply in October, putting additional pressure on reception and emergency services on some of the Canary Islands, particularly the smaller and less densely populated ones.

Migrant arrivals in the archipelago have fallen 18% year on year to 11,527 people, according to the office of the Spanish government’s representative in the Canary Islands.

(Reporting by Graham Keeley, Mireia Merino and Miguel Gutierrez; Editing by Paul Simao)

item.title: 米オラクル、200億ドル調達へ ＡＩ・クラウド投資に充当
item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 米ソフトウエア大手オラクルが社債と株式の発行を通じて２００億ドルを調達する計画であることが、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米オラクル、200億ドル調達へ　ＡＩ・クラウド投資に充当 11/2 23:43 配信

2025年9月9日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [２日 ロイター] - 米ソフトウエア大手オラクルが社債と株式の発行を通じて２００億ドルを調達する計画であることが、２日に提出された規制当局向け文書で分かった。人工知能（ＡＩ）・クラウドインフラの拡充に向けた資金調達とみられる。

発行する社債は満期が２９─４６年の６本で、変動金利債１本と固定金利債５本で構成する。金利や発行価格、株式の発行数は未定。

今回の資金調達は、３０年度までに売上高を３倍超に拡大することを目指す同社のＡＩ投資の規模を浮き彫りにしている。

同社は先週、設備投資は今期および来期にピークを迎えた後で減少すると予想し、３０年度（２９年６月－３０年５月）までのＡＩ関連の追加資金調達額は最大２００億ドルに抑える方針も明らかにした。

同社株は市場前取引で４％下落した。１０月３０日までの年初来下落率は約３３％。

item.title: 欧州スーパー冷蔵設備に再びサイバー攻撃、温度上昇で食品廃棄相次ぐ
item.description:
Marie Mannes Helen Reid Louise Rasmussen
[ストックホルム／ブリュッセル／ロンドン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Marie Mannes　Helen Reid　Louise Rasmussen

[ストックホルム／ブリュッセル／ロンドン ２日 ロイター] - 欧州のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵設備を標的にしたサイバー攻撃が再び発生しており、スウェーデンからベルギーに至る欧州各地の店舗で２日、冷蔵設備の温度が上昇する事態となった。

スーパーチェーンのアホールド・デハゼイとコルライトによると、夜間に発生したＩＴ障害によりベルギーとルクセンブルクの数十店舗の冷蔵・冷凍設備が被害を受けた。スウェーデンの食料品チェーンＩＣＡとコープも同様に温度が急上昇したと報告した。

ストックホルムにあるＩＣＡのフランチャイズ店のセールスマネージャー、エングラ・イングウォール氏はロイターに対し、「サイバー攻撃があり、全ての冷凍庫が５０度に達した」と述べた。攻撃は午前２時（日本時間午前１０時）に発生したが、気付いたのは数時間後だったとし、「全て駄目になった」と語った。

スウェーデンの国家サイバーセキュリティーセンター責任者のジョン・ビロウ氏は２日、国内各地の食品店に影響を及ぼす複数の事案に対応しているとしつつ、誰が攻撃の背後にいるかについては推測することはできないと述べた。

フランスでも先月、多数のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵・冷凍設備を標的にした大規模なサイバー攻撃が行われ、冷蔵庫や冷凍庫の温度が一晩で最高５０度まで上昇。これにより食品の損失や火災が発生していた。

item.title: Marvell llega a un acuerdo de US$115.000 millones para adquirir Lumentum Holdings
item.description: La transacción, realizada íntegramente con acciones, otorgará a los accionistas de Marvell el 67% de la compañía resultante, según un comunicado que confirma un informe previo de Bloomberg News que in ...
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gould, Michelle Davis, David Carnevali
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Marvell Technology Inc. ( MRVL ) ha llegado a un acuerdo para comprar el fabricante de componentes ópticos para centros de datos Lumentum Holdings Inc. por un valor empresarial de US$115.000 millones, una de las mayores fusiones tecnológicas de la historia, en una carrera por capitalizar el auge de la inteligencia artificial. La transacción, realizada íntegramente con acciones, otorgará a los accionistas de Marvell el 67% de la compañía resultante, según un comunicado que confirma un informe previo de Bloomberg News que indicaba que las dos empresas de Silicon Valley estaban cerca de cerrar un acuerdo. Se espera que la operación se concrete en el primer semestre de 2028, según informaron las compañías. Ver más: Nvidia invierte US$2.000 millones en Marvell y anuncia una alianza En términos de capital, se trata de la mayor operación de fusión y adquisición del año y la mayor de la historia en el sector tecnológico mundial, excluyendo la fusión entre SpaceX y xAI, según muestran los datos recopilados por Bloomberg . La operación pone de manifiesto cómo la inteligencia artificial está impulsando acuerdos en casi todos los sectores y regiones importantes, desde fabricantes de chips y otros proveedores tecnológicos especializados hasta operadores de centros de datos y empresas de suministro eléctrico. Las acciones de Lumentum cerraron el viernes a US$840,70 tras registrar una subida del 128% este año, lo que otorga a la empresa con sede en San José un valor de mercado de unos US$76.000 millones. Marvell, con una subida del 131% este año, estaba valorada el viernes en US$172.200 millones. Lumentum fabrica láseres y otra tecnología óptica para transmitir enormes cantidades de datos a gran velocidad. Ese hardware sustenta el auge de la IA, ya que permite a los centros de datos y a las empresas de telecomunicaciones transmitir información entre servidores, instalaciones y otros destinos. Marvell ya adquiere tecnología láser de Lumentum, y la empresa más grande ha ido aumentando su apuesta por la tecnología óptica y fotónica para conectar los equipos de los centros de datos. A principios de este año, Marvell adquirió la empresa de fotónica Celestial AI. Ver más: Amazon recurre a créditos de proveedores por hasta US$80.000 millones para financiar su apuesta por la IA Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) anunció en marzo un acuerdo para adquirir una participación de US$2.000 millones en Lumentum, como parte de un acuerdo que incluía la colaboración en el ámbito de la fotónica, que utiliza la luz en lugar del cableado tradicional de cobre para transmitir datos de forma más rápida y eficiente. Marvell también colabora con la unidad de nube de Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) y con Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) para ayudar a desarrollar chips de IA a medida. En agosto, la empresa cerró un acuerdo sobre chips con Google, de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), para dar soporte a las unidades de procesamiento tensorial de Google. Qatalyst Partners actúa como asesor financiero principal de Marvell, y Goldman Sachs Group Inc. ( GS ) y JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM ) también colaboran con la empresa. Citigroup Inc. ( C ) y Evercore Inc. asesoran a Lumentum. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

LONDON, Nov 2 : Google parent Alphabet is selling €6 billion ($6.7 billion) of bonds on Monday, according to a memo from one of the deal's managers, testing investor appetite after doubts about the AI trade triggered a recent selloff in tech stocks and debt. Alphabet is offering the new bonds in seven tranches, with total demand just over €17 billion, the memo from one of the banks arranging the sale seen by Reuters showed.  The bonds, expected to be priced later on Monday, have maturities ranging from 2 to 19 years. They include one floating-rate tranche and six fixed-rate tranches, according to an SEC filing. The offer marks Alphabet's second euro-denominated sale this year. In May, it sold €9 billion of bonds across six tranches, following a rare 100-year sterling bond sale in February.

Concerns about the financing required to support heavy spending on artificial intelligence, and the returns needed to justify that investment, have weighed on technology stocks and bonds in recent weeks. The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 5 per cent in October. The latest bout of volatility has been fuelled by disappointing quarterly results from Alphabet and Amazon, two of the biggest spenders on data centres. Alphabet said it intended to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying outstanding debt. Barclays, BNP Paribas and Deutsche Bank are the joint book-running managers for the offering, according to the SEC filing. Alphabet's shares fell more than 12 per cent last Thursday, their worst day ever, wiping out roughly $500 billion in market value after its quarterly results showed slower-than-expected growth in Google Search and cash burn that rattled investors. For the whole year, the company expects capital spending of as much as $205 billion. As of September 30, Alphabet had also signed leases, mainly for data centres, that have not yet commenced, with future payments of $130.5 billion that are not yet recorded on its balance sheet, the SEC filing showed. Microsoft, by contrast, was the only Big Tech company generating cash in the quarter. Still, analysts expect major tech companies to step up bond sales in Europe to fund infrastructure investment, tapping the region's deep and liquid debt markets. Alphabet shares were up about 1 per cent in premarket trading. The company's US-listed shares fell nearly 19 per cent in October, their worst monthly performance on record. Its dollar-denominated 4.1 per cent bond due in 2031 was little changed on Monday at about 95.43 cents on the dollar. ($1 = 0.8948 euros)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Binance registra retiros por US$4.700 millones tras un hackeo sin precedentes
item.description: Estas salidas representan menos del 3% de los US$166.000 millones en activos que posee la mayor plataforma de criptomonedas del mundo, añadió el portavoz.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Weeks
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los operadores han retirado miles de millones de dólares de Binance desde finales de la semana pasada, cuando el gigante de los intercambios de criptomonedas sufrió el mayor robo cibernético de la historia. Según un portavoz de Binance, los retiros netos de la plataforma alcanzaron los US$4.700 millones el lunes por la mañana en Londres. Estas salidas representan menos del 3% de los US$166.000 millones en activos que posee la mayor plataforma de criptomonedas del mundo, añadió el portavoz. Ver más: Bitcoin resiste el hackeo a Binance mientras operadores evalúan el riesgo de nuevos ataques informáticos Binance restableció los retiros de sus clientes el domingo, tras haberlos congelado a raíz del ataque de US$6.400 millones, que el FBI atribuyó a hackers norcoreanos. Tras detectarse el ataque el jueves por la noche, Binance colaboró con socios del sector, incluidos emisores de stablecoins, para congelar rápidamente casi la mitad de los fondos robados. La compañía se comprometió a cubrir la totalidad de las pérdidas y, hasta el domingo, había solucionado aproximadamente el 95% del total. Los retiros se han mantenido dentro de las previsiones de la plataforma, según ha señalado el portavoz de Binance, quien ha añadido que los depósitos han ido “aumentando de forma constante”. Por su parte, el mercado de activos digitales en general se ha mantenido relativamente estable tras el incidente. El bitcoin, referente del sector, apenas ha variado, cotizando en torno a los US$77.700 este lunes. La forma en que Binance ha absorbido el impacto hasta ahora es “absolutamente asombrosa”, afirmó Karl-Martin Ahrend, cofundador de Areta, una firma de asesoría especializada en activos digitales. Si bien es “totalmente previsible” que se produzcan algunas salidas de capital y reajustes por parte de los operadores, señaló, no prevé un impacto a largo plazo. Por el momento, los operadores parecen estar de acuerdo. Julia Zhou, presidenta y cofundadora de Caladan, una entidad creadora de mercado de criptomonedas, puso como ejemplo el segundo mayor ataque informático de la historia de las criptomonedas para contextualizar la situación. La plataforma de intercambio de activos digitales Bybit perdió el año pasado aproximadamente US$1.500 millones a causa de un ataque que el FBI también relacionó con Corea del Norte. El incidente fue seguido de una avalancha de retiradas de fondos, pero los reembolsos acabaron estabilizándose. “Desde la perspectiva de la creación de mercado, también estamos analizando los flujos netos, si los depósitos regresan, cómo se mantienen la liquidez y la profundidad del mercado, y si los fondos se están trasladando a otras plataformas”, dijo Zhou. “En última instancia, la prueba más importante es si Binance puede mantener las condiciones normales de negociación”. El domingo, Yi He, co-CEO de Binance, afirmó en una publicación en X que no todos los retiros provenían de clientes, sino que algunos eran transferencias entre billeteras de Binance. Ver más: Binance reanuda los retiros mientras persisten las dudas sobre el ataque informático El mercado de las criptomonedas en general se ha enfrentado este año a un aumento de los delitos cibernéticos, impulsado en parte por la creciente sofisticación y disponibilidad de las herramientas de inteligencia artificial. La oleada de ataques ha dejado al descubierto a las principales plataformas de criptomonedas, a las aplicaciones de finanzas descentralizadas e incluso a las carteras de hardware, consideradas durante mucho tiempo la forma más segura de almacenar tokens. En septiembre se sustrajeron cientos de millones de dólares de Bitget, una plataforma de intercambio. Los piratas informáticos también robaron más de US$100 millones en bitcoins de carteras protegidas por dispositivos de Coinkite Inc., mientras que la manipulación de dispositivos Ledger provocó pérdidas por valor de millones de dólares. El poseedor promedio de criptomonedas “puede sentirse un poco estancado”, dijo Nick Smart, director de inteligencia de la plataforma de análisis de criptomonedas Crystal Intelligence. “Binance sigue siendo la plataforma de intercambio dominante a pesar de las salidas de capital. Así que, aunque la plataforma se vea afectada, está lejos de estar perdida”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Apple llega a sus resultados con una valoración récord y poco margen para decepcionar a Wall Street
item.description: Las ganancias han llevado a que la acción cotice a sus niveles más altos desde 2008, lo que la hace particularmente vulnerable si los resultados de la compañía no cumplen con las expectativas.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Vlastelica
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El alza de las acciones de Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) en los últimos meses ha dejado poco margen para decepciones cuando el fabricante del iPhone presente sus resultados trimestrales este lunes, después del cierre del mercado. Las acciones han subido un 25% desde su mínimo a finales de junio, lo que ha añadido aproximadamente US$1 billón a su valor de mercado, ya que el crecimiento constante de los ingresos de la compañía y el aumento del flujo de caja libre han ofrecido un refugio a los inversores preocupados por el elevado gasto en infraestructura de IA por parte de empresas de gran capitalización como Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ) y Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ). Ver más: Apple supera a Nvidia y vuelve a ser la empresa más valiosa del mundo Las ganancias han llevado a que la acción cotice a sus niveles más altos desde 2008, lo que la hace particularmente vulnerable si los resultados de la compañía no cumplen con las expectativas. Con un múltiplo de 36 veces las ganancias previstas para los próximos 12 meses, las acciones son casi el doble de caras que el índice S&P 500, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg . “Apple se encuentra en el percentil 99 de su valoración histórica, y cuando un valor está tan sobrevalorado, existe riesgo si surge algún imprevisto”, afirmó Ben Carew, codirector de inversiones de Tandem Investment Advisors, que posee acciones de la compañía. “Actualmente, actúa como refugio seguro, pero si su crecimiento es menor de lo que anticipa el mercado, la gente lo percibiría como menos seguro y podríamos ver una revalorización de su múltiplo”. Se trata de un riesgo que debería resultar familiar a quienes siguen de cerca a Apple. Hace tres meses, la acción sufrió su peor caída en un solo día en 16 meses después de que la escasez de componentes lastrara sus previsiones de ingresos trimestrales. Ver más: Apple estrena el MacBook Pro con pantalla táctil tras dos décadas de rechazo y precios desde US$2.899 Wall Street prevé que los ingresos del cuarto trimestre fiscal aumenten un 11%, hasta alcanzar los US$113.500 millones, y que el beneficio neto crezca un 6%, hasta los US$29.200 millones. Si bien esto limitaría el mejor año de Apple en cuanto a crecimiento de ventas desde 2021 al 15%, se espera que la expansión se ralentice en los próximos dos años, según el promedio de las estimaciones de los analistas recopiladas por Bloomberg . El informe de Apple ofrecerá la primera información fidedigna sobre la popularidad de su nuevo iPhone plegable. El dispositivo salió a la venta recientemente y la compañía afirmó que la demanda ha sido extraordinaria, lo que ha provocado que los plazos de entrega se retrasen hasta el próximo año. Sin embargo, los analistas creen que esto podría deberse a la limitada disponibilidad de suministro, mientras que los informes sobre pantallas del Duo que se agrietan tras un uso limitado podrían disminuir el atractivo del producto entre quienes no lo adoptaron en sus inicios. El Duo es crucial para Apple. No solo representa el mayor cambio de diseño en el producto estrella de la compañía en años, sino que su precio inicial es de US$1.999, y los inversores esperan que este precio elevado impulse el crecimiento. Según estimaciones de Bloomberg Intelligence, el teléfono podría generar entre US$28.000 y US$32.000 millones en ventas durante el año fiscal 2027 y elevar el precio medio de venta a medida que los consumidores migren desde los modelos Pro y Pro Max, más económicos. Ver más: Apple presenta nuevos iMac y MacBook Pro como antesala de su portátil con pantalla táctil La estrategia de convertir a Apple en un refugio seguro para la tecnología quedó patente la semana pasada, cuando los decepcionantes informes de ganancias de Alphabet y Amazon provocaron una fuga de inversores de las acciones de empresas con exposición a la IA. El índice de semiconductores de la Bolsa de Filadelfia se desplomó un 7,2% el viernes, su peor sesión desde junio, mientras que las acciones de Apple superaron al S&P 500 con un descenso del 1,2%. Con las acciones de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) arrastradas por la caída, Apple superó al fabricante de chips el viernes para convertirse en la empresa más valiosa del mundo por primera vez desde julio, con una capitalización de mercado de US$5,03 billones. Aunque el crecimiento de los ingresos de Apple va a la zaga del de la mayoría de sus competidores del sector de las grandes tecnológicas, la empresa destaca en flujo de caja libre, un indicador que ha cobrado especial relevancia ahora que los inversores se muestran escépticos ante la fiebre de gasto en IA. Para su ejercicio fiscal de 2026, se prevé que el flujo de caja libre aumente más del 40% hasta alcanzar los US$141.500 millones, y se espera un crecimiento adicional en los tres ejercicios fiscales siguientes. Por el contrario, Alphabet, Meta y Amazon presentan déficits de flujo de caja libre que se prevé que continúen. “El mercado valora la solidez del flujo de caja libre de Apple, y si logra mantener ese nivel, creo que la acción puede generar valor adicional desde los niveles actuales”, afirmó Daniel Flax, analista sénior de investigación en Neuberger Berman. “Su capacidad para ejecutar el ciclo de productos y traducirlo en un sólido crecimiento del flujo de caja libre es lo que más importará para la acción, y los primeros indicios, al menos, apuntan a que existe un gran interés por el Duo”. Ver más: Las marcas más valiosas del mundo en 2026: Apple lidera y Nvidia registra el mayor salto Sin embargo, la combinación de un múltiplo elevado y un crecimiento bajo ha moderado el entusiasmo de Wall Street por la acción. Desde el último informe de Apple a finales de julio, al menos seis analistas han rebajado sus calificaciones. Loop Capital redujo su recomendación de compra a mantener en octubre, citando las tendencias de envíos del iPhone, y Bank of America la eliminó de su lista de las mejores ideas de inversión en EE.UU. el viernes, indicando que se muestra “cauteloso ante la situación a corto plazo, dados los posibles obstáculos en comparación con el consenso”. Menos del 60% de los analistas consultados por Bloomberg recomiendan comprar, en comparación con más del 90% para Microsoft, Amazon y Meta. Además, la acción cotiza por encima del precio objetivo promedio de los analistas, lo que la convierte en la única acción de las Siete Magníficas con una rentabilidad implícita negativa en los próximos 12 meses. “La valoración es el principal riesgo al que se enfrenta Apple, pero merece cierta prima dado que existe mucha más certeza en torno a su modelo de negocio”, afirmó Carew, de Tandem. “La volatilidad que observamos en otros sectores tecnológicos refleja la incertidumbre que rodea a Apple. Salvo que se publique un informe que ponga en entredicho la situación de Apple, algo que no preveo, debería al menos mantenerse al margen de parte de esa volatilidad”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

MADRID, Nov 2 : Atletico Madrid manager Diego Simeone hailed Harry Kane as a worthy Ballon d'Or winner as his buoyant side prepare to put their nine-game unbeaten run on the line against Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Tuesday. Simeone praised the England captain's enduring scoring instinct ahead of the clash at the Metropolitano stadium. "Firstly, I'd like to congratulate him on his well-deserved Ballon d'Or. It's incredible – I've always admired him," Simeone said. "As he's matured over the years, he's found his best form without losing his eye for goal; he knows what the team needs."

Nov 2 : Jake Paul will face former kickboxing world champion Cedric Doumbe in Dubai on December 24 in his first bout since a knockout loss to Anthony Joshua last year. Paul fractured his jaw in two places during the sixth-round stoppage defeat by Britain's former heavyweight champion in Miami last December and underwent multiple surgeries before announcing his return to the ring in October. "Cedric ...  was calling me out two years ago after knocking a guy out in nine seconds. Well, now you get your chance," Paul said in a statement. "I'm rusty, my jaw isn't quite right and I don't have kickboxing world titles like you do. But this isn't kickboxing, mon ami. This is boxing.

Oracle taps investors for $20 billion to finance AI expansion

FAST

Nov 2 : Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bond and share sales, regulatory filings showed on Monday, as the software giant taps investors to fund its costly AI and cloud infrastructure build-out. Shares of the company fell nearly 6 per cent, extending a roughly 33 per cent decline this year through Friday. Oracle said it would use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including capital spending, debt repayment, acquisitions, dividends and share buybacks. The fundraising underscores the scale of Oracle's AI investment as it seeks to more than triple revenue by fiscal 2030. The company said last week that capital spending would peak this fiscal year and the next, while pledging to raise no more than $20 billion in additional financing for AI through fiscal 2030.

Shares rallied about 11 per cent on Wednesday after CFO Hilary Maxson said Oracle also expects free cash flow to turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028. Oracle had $125.34 billion in notes payable and other borrowings as of August 31, compared with fiscal 2026 revenue of $67.36 billion. It expects revenue to exceed $225 billion and adjusted earnings to top $21 per share in fiscal 2030.  Wall Street expects the company's adjusted profit per share for fiscal 2027 to be $8.14, according to data compiled by LSEG. The bond offering comprises six tranches maturing between 2029 and 2046, including one floating-rate tranche and five fixed-rate tranches. Interest rates, prices and the number of shares have not been set. Oracle’s existing 6.85 per cent bonds due in 2066 fell more than 1.2 cents on the dollar, according to Tradeweb data.  Investors have focused on Oracle's AI spending because it lacks the revenue scale of cloud rivals Microsoft and Amazon and has significant exposure to OpenAI, the loss-making developer of ChatGPT.

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 2 : The dollar eased on Monday as oil prices tumbled and equities climbed ahead of a week full of catalysts, including the US midterm elections, a host of data on the US labor market and multiple central bank rate decisions. Crude prices tumbled about 6 per cent as continuing talks between Iranian and Qatari officials on ending the US-Israeli war with Iran lifted hopes for reduced disruptions to supply from the Middle East. The easing of oil prices helped buoy stocks after the Nasdaq suffered in October its biggest monthly percentage decline since March 2025, largely due to growing concerns about massive spending by companies on the emerging AI technology. "What we have broadly is just a resilient market. Oil prices, the December WTI tested 105 on Friday, and we're below 100 now," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets in New York.

"When we went into the weekend, everything looked bad. Stocks had sold off, oil was at new contract highs in the December WTI. And we come back from the weekend, and this is a collective sigh of relief." The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.38 per cent to 101.59 and was on track for its biggest daily percentage decline since October 15. The euro was up 0.48 per cent at $1.1212, even after late Friday's revision by Fitch of France's outlook to "negative" from "stable." MANUFACTURING INDEX RISES IN OCTOBER On the data front, the Institute for Supply Management said its manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) increased to 55.5 last month from 54.5 in September, while input prices remained elevated. Markets will also deal with a flurry of data on the labor market this week, culminating on Friday with the government's key October payrolls report. The S&P Global Eurozone Manufacturing PMI showed manufacturing activity growth in the region held up well in October, albeit easing as new order growth slowed and rising costs from energy and supply-chain disruptions squeezed margins. Multiple central banks are scheduled to issue policy statements this week, including those in Britain, Australia, Norway and Sweden. CRYPTO MARKETS STEADY AFTER BINANCE HACK In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 0.06 per cent to $77,765.90 and ether rose 1.06 per cent to $2,286.31, steadying slightly following last week's record $6.3 billion heist at Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange. Binance's customers have withdrawn almost $5 billion from the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange since it reopened after the hack, the company said. Americans head to the polls on Tuesday to determine whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from US President Donald Trump's Republican Party, with the economy and high prices key issues among voters. Democrats are widely predicted to win the House of Representatives, but wresting control of the Senate may prove more difficult. Sterling strengthened 0.22 per cent to $1.3424. PMI data showed British manufacturers started the final quarter of 2026 with the strongest output growth in more than two years, although fast-rising costs may worry the Bank of England, which looks set to raise interest rates this week. Against the Japanese yen, the dollar strengthened 0.08 per cent to 157.66. Japan's real interest rates have risen recently, especially in the long- and super-long zones, the central bank said in a full version of its quarterly outlook report.

item.title: Analysis-Trump’s Iran threat renews Gulf fears of a war it didn’t choose
item.description: By Samia Nakhoul, Alexander Cornwell and Timour Azhari MANAMA, Nov 2 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump’s threat to strike Iran again confronts America’s Gulf allies with a stark prospect: another ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters

Analysis-Trump’s Iran threat renews Gulf fears of a war it didn’t choose

Reuters

02 November, 2026 06:00 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

By Samia Nakhoul, Alexander Cornwell and Timour Azhari MANAMA, Nov 2 (Reuters) – US President Donald Trump’s threat to strike Iran again confronts America’s Gulf allies with a stark prospect: another war decided in Washington in which the US bases built to protect them could instead make them targets for harsh Iranian reprisal.

Iranian missiles that struck US military bases and Gulf energy facilities in the last round of fighting exposed a vulnerability at the heart of Washington’s decades-old security architecture. Rather than deterring Tehran, America’s sprawling regional footprint gave Iran fixed targets and the Gulf states hosting them pressure points it can exploit.

That prospect dominated discussions among ministers, policymakers and security officials at the annual Manama Dialogue security conference in Bahrain over the weekend, as governments weighed what another round of war could mean for US forces and the countries that host them.

Show Full Article

The urgency has grown as Trump again threatened military action, saying he could launch “another little Operation Epic Fury” after Tuesday’s midterm elections, referring to the US-Israeli operation that began on Feb 28. Four European officials said the US had amassed enough forces and assets in the region to attack Iran at short notice, possibly as soon as this week.

“War is coming,” said a fifth European official who has close contact with Gulf leaders. “Nobody is in favour of this war.”

Egypt’s Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty told the Manama conference another round of fighting would be more dangerous and destructive than the last: “It will lead to nowhere.”

FROM SHIELD TO TARGET

Two of the European officials told Reuters any US attack would likely target Iranian nuclear sites, including research and development facilities. Among likely locations is Pickaxe Mountain, a site linked to Iran’s nuclear program, although the officials said military action would probably be able only to weaken Tehran’s capabilities rather than destroy them.

Iranian officials have told Reuters that Tehran has drawn up detailed target lists in retaliation for another US-Israeli attack, including undersea communications cables and military bases, some covert.

The strategy could widen the cost of war beyond the battlefield, with energy infrastructure, desalination plants, communications networks and highly visible targets in Gulf cities at risk.

Iran cannot match the United States and Israel militarily. But it does not need to, three delegates said. Its strategy is increasingly one of attrition: make US forces expensive to defend and sustain, turn the Gulf states hosting them into pressure points, and leverage any American retrenchment as evidence that Washington cannot protect its partners.

“What the Iranians really care about is the departure of US forces from the region,” said Emile Hokayem, director of regional security at The International Institute for Strategic Studies, which organises the Manama conference.

Tehran’s message to Gulf powers, he told Reuters, is mainly: “You spent four decades investing in the US and after 40 years, those bases didn’t protect you, they exposed you.”

Nowhere is that argument more potent than Bahrain, headquarters of the US Fifth Fleet and for decades an anchor of American military power in the region. Near its base in Juffair, the scars of strikes were still visible metres from residential areas: the corrugated iron roof and front of a warehouse were torn open and charred where projectiles had struck, while a radar facing Iran was missing a third of its dish.

The damage has forced Washington to confront a question far beyond Bahrain: whether to rebuild, harden or withdraw a military footprint built to project US power, not withstand sustained missile and drone attacks.

THE GULF PAYS THE PRICE

For Bahrain, fears of Iranian threats are layered onto an older sectarian and historical faultline. In 2011, mass protests led largely by the Shi’ite community challenged the Sunni Al Khalifa monarchy. Bahrain’s rulers crushed the revolt and accused Iran of manipulating the unrest, a charge Tehran denied.

Since the latest war began, some Iranian hardliners have again invoked Bahrain as Iran’s “14th province”, despite Tehran abandoning its territorial claim in 1970. Against that history, strikes on US facilities threaten not only America’s military presence in Bahrain but the kingdom hosting it.

“We’re basically looking at the worst-case scenario,” a Gulf official told Reuters, anticipating that the US would soon strike Iran, leading to Iranian retaliation against civilian infrastructure across the Gulf.

Another Gulf official said that “in the end, only one person decides” whether conflict resumes and how intense it becomes, a reference to Trump that underscored the Gulf states’ limited power to shape a conflict whose consequences they would bear.

In response to questions for this article, a White House official said “all options” remained available and Iran faced “the easy way or the hard way,” adding: “President Trump holds all the cards.”

“The Iranian campaign is to exhaust the Americans. It’s not to win,” Hokayem added. “They can force you to spend more energy, more weapons, more money over time.”

RACING TO AVERT ANOTHER WAR

That concern is pushing Gulf states towards diplomacy. Senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held talks with Iranian officials in Tehran last month, with Saudi Arabia saying the effort was intended to “prevent the return of military escalation.” Qatari officials also held meetings in Tehran and Doha over the weekend to avert renewed war.

“We are hoping that there is a diplomatic breakthrough. We don’t really want to see another round of confrontation in the region,” United Arab Emirates senior official Anwar Gargash told the Manama conference.

The UAE was, however, “braced for the worst,” he said.

The European official close to Gulf leaders said there was deep pessimism about whether diplomacy can bridge the Washington-Tehran divide, with renewed war seen as a matter of when, not if.

The question is no longer whether Washington remains committed to the Gulf, but what a US security guarantee means when the infrastructure underpinning it is itself a target.

The contest may be shifting from who can inflict the greatest military damage to who can endure the costs longest. For Washington’s Gulf partners, the fear is that another round of war could leave them paying much of the price.

(Additional reporting by Alexander Cornwell and Timour Azhari in Manama and Parisa Hafezi in Dubai; Writing by Samia Nakhoul, Editing by William Maclean)

item.title: Singapore Denies Probe Into Reported Chinese Spy Plot Linked to Nvidia Boss
item.description: Singapore has denied investigating a Chinese executive reportedly close to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, rejecting claims made in a Wall Street Journal report that authorities were “concerned” about possible Chinese espionage. The Journal said in an article published on Friday that officials in the United States, …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Singapore has denied investigating a Chinese executive reportedly close to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, rejecting claims made in a Wall Street Journal report that authorities were “concerned” about possible Chinese espionage.

The Journal said in an article published on Friday that officials in the United States, Taiwan and Singapore “have grown concerned” about the ties between the Nvidia boss and Alice Huang of Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed International.

The ties “potentially” gave “Beijing access to information about the world’s most valuable artificial-intelligence chips”, the report said.

Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs said at the weekend that neither the government nor officials had expressed concerns about Alice Huang’s ties to the Nvidia boss or suspicions she was a Chinese intelligence source.

“The WSJ article cites sources that Singapore officials were concerned with Alice Huang’s close ties to Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang or her being an alleged Chinese intelligence source, and had separately investigated her ties to China,” the ministry said in a statement issued Saturday.

“We would like to make clear that neither the Singapore Government nor its officials said this. And there were no such investigations conducted in respect of Alice Huang.”

Nvidia is the world’s most valuable company thanks to the global drive to build data centres packed with specialist computer chips and other hardware that runs AI systems.

The Singaporean statement made no mention of a separate report by the New York Times which China described on Friday as “groundless speculation”.

That report said that the Nvidia chief was the target of a Chinese spy plot and also mentioned his ties with Alice Huang.

AFP attempted to contact Megaspeed for comment on Friday, but when calling the phone number listed on its website, the person who answered said they were unfamiliar with the company and that the number was a residential line.

item.title: 緊急警報アプリにハッキング、ウクライナとロシアで核攻撃など偽警報
item.description: [キーウ ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２日 ロイター] - ウクライナとロシアは２日、夜間に緊急警報アプリがハッキングされ、空襲や化学・核攻撃が迫っているとの偽の警報が市民に送信されたと発表した。

ウクライナの市民向け空襲警報アプリは、首都キーウなどで１日午後１１時（２１００ＧＭＴ、日本時間２日午前６時）前から放射線の危険や化学攻撃、一部地域での市街戦の可能性を知らせる偽の警報を送信し始めた。

偽警報の一つは、核弾頭を搭載可能な極超音速ミサイル「オレシュニク」をロシアが発射しウクライナ全土に核警報が発令されたというものだった。

ウクライナ空軍は直後に、警報システムがロシアによるハッキングを受けたとみられると対話アプリ「テレグラム」で発表。警報はロシア語で発信されたと指摘した。ウクライナでは、公的な情報発信にはウクライナ語の使用が義務付けられている。

各警報にはほどなくして解除通知が送信された。ウクライナのデジタル転換省は、緊急警報アプリを一時停止したと発表したが他の警報手段や空襲警報のサイレンは機能していると説明した。

＜ロシア非常事態省もサイバー攻撃発表＞

この数時間後、ロシア国営タス通信は、非常事態省の発表として、同省の携帯端末向けアプリが大規模なサイバー攻撃を受け、市民に偽情報が拡散したと報じた。

親ウクライナのハッカー集団「アテシュ」は２日未明、テレグラムに警報メッセージのスクリーンショットを掲載し、「非常事態省のアプリがハッキングされた」と投稿。ただ、ロシア非常事態省は、このアプリは市民向け警報システムの補助的伝達手段で影響は限定的との見方を示した。

偽メッセージではロシア市民に対し、全地域に向けて核弾頭が発射されたと伝え、３週間分の食料を備蓄して地下室に避難するよう促していた。非常事態省はテレグラムの声明で、専門家がアプリの正常な運用の復旧に取り組んでいると説明した。

ロイターはどの組織が関与したのか現時点で確認できていない。２０２２年２月のロシアによるウクライナ全面侵攻開始以降に発生したサイバーセキュリティーを巡る事案について、活動家系ハッカー集団に加え、ロシアとウクライナ双方の情報機関との関連を指摘する専門家もいる。

item.title: 米司法省、中間選挙に介入の構え 中立性に懸念の声
item.description:
Andrew Goudsward Luc Cohen
[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Goudsward　Luc Cohen

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の下で、司法省は３日の中間選挙に直接介入する姿勢を示している。特定の政党や候補者を利するために法執行権限を使っているとみられないよう、数十年にわたり守られてきた慣行からの転換だ。

カリフォルニア州では、司法省が約２万人の郵便投票を他の票と区別して取り置くよう求めた。これらの有権者は米国籍を持たず、投票資格がない可能性が高いと主張している。

アラスカ州では、共和党現職のダン・サリバン上院議員と同姓同名の候補が、有権者を混乱させる目的で立候補したかどうかを巡り、司法省が刑事捜査を強化した。同議員が僅差で敗れた場合に選挙結果の認定を阻止するよう求める訴訟も起こしたが、連邦判事が１日、訴えを退けた。

両州を相手取った司法省の訴えは、いずれも裁判所に退けられた。それでも、開票や結果の認定を待たずに選挙を巡る争いに介入しようとする同省の姿勢が浮き彫りになった。

トランプ氏が中間選挙への疑念を広めようとした場合、司法省がその動きを加速させかねないと懸念する声が上がっている。司法省による選挙への介入は従来、人種的少数派や弱い立場にある人々が支障なく投票できるようにするための連邦法の執行が中心だった。

ブランチ司法長官は、同省の取り組みは合法で、投票の公正さを守ることが目的だとしている。司法省のペルズ報道官は声明で「司法省はどの陣営にも肩入れしていない。法律を執行しているだけだ」と述べた。

司法省で公民権への脅威に対する選挙対応の責任者を務め、その後「法の支配プロジェクト」を設立したマーク・ブルームバーグ氏は「政権は以前なら禁じられていた形で司法省に影響力を持たせたいようだ」と語った。

共和党のジョージ・Ｗ・ブッシュ大統領の下で司法長官代行を務めたピーター・カイスラー氏は「司法省が法執行の判断で信頼を得るには、政党間の争いでどちら側にも立たないことを人々に理解してもらう必要がある」と述べた。アラスカ州の訴訟について「肩入れしているように見えるだけでなく、実際に肩入れしているのが明らかだ」と指摘した。

＜トランプ氏が任命した幹部の権限拡大＞

司法省は従来、選挙を巡る捜査に慎重に臨んできた。司法省が関与すると不透明感が生じたり、候補者や政党に利用されたりする恐れがあるためだ。

司法省の元当局者によると、選挙法に精通した専門家で構成する公職不正担当部門は、選挙結果が認定されるまで介入を控えるよう捜査官や検察官に助言することが多かった。

トランプ政権は同部門を大幅に縮小し、選挙汚職の捜査で連邦検察官に同部門との協議を義務付ける規定の適用を停止した。関係者３人によると、 捜査官や検察官には、解決できない問題はトランプ氏が政治任用した幹部が判断すると伝えられた。

捜査官と検察官の間で意見が対立した場合は司法副長官室が調整に当たるという。司法省の元当局者は、選挙関連の捜査で同室がこうした直接的な役割を担うことはほとんどなかったと指摘した。

item.title: 英製造業ＰＭＩ、10月は5カ月ぶり高水準 生産と受注が伸び加速
item.description:
David Milliken
［ロンドン ２日 ロイター］ - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２日発表した英国の１０月の製造業購買...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英製造業ＰＭＩ、10月は5カ月ぶり高水準　生産と受注が伸び加速 11/2 19:43 配信

日産自動車のサンダーランド工場で2025年12月撮影 REUTERS/Phil Noble（ロイター） David Milliken

［ロンドン　２日　ロイター］ - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２日発表した英国の１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）改定値は５２．８で、９月の５１．９から上昇し、５カ月ぶりの高水準となった。速報値と同じだった。

生産指数は５１．５から５３．６に上昇し、２０２４年９月以来の高水準となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのディレクター、ロブ・ドブソン氏は「１０月は生産と新規受注の伸びがいずれも加速した。中国本土や欧州連合（ＥＵ）、米国からの新規受注を含め、企業は国内外の市場で需要が改善している兆しに対応した」と述べた。

その他の主な内容は以下の通り。

・投入コストは６月以来の速いペースで上昇した。前回大幅に上昇した２０２２年以降で、有数の伸び。

・生産見通しは、２０２５年１１月以来の大幅な改善。

・新規受注の伸びは７月以来の大きさ。

・６カ月間拡大していた雇用は伸びは止まった。特に小規模メーカーが、人件費の高さと投入価格の上昇による圧迫を理由に挙げた。

・最新の公式統計によると、８月までの１２カ月間の製造業生産は３．０％増と、２４年３月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。

・Ｓ＆Ｐの調査期間は１０月１２─２７日で、ヒーリー財務相が初の予算案を発表する前だった。予算案では企業への増税がおおむね見送られた一方、２０２７年の最低賃金引き上げが発表された。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 11/2(月) 19:43 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＥＣＢは追加利上げ必要、市場は過小評価も＝スロバキア中銀総裁
item.description: [フランクフルト ２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのカジミール・スロバキア中銀総裁は２日、高...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢは追加利上げ必要、市場は過小評価も＝スロバキア中銀総裁 11/2 19:40 配信

カジミール・スロバキア中銀総裁、6月30日撮影 REUTERS/Pedro Rocha（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのカジミール・スロバキア中銀総裁は２日、高インフレの定着を防ぐため、ＥＣＢは追加利上げが必要との見解を示した。物価上昇圧力を抑えるのに必要な対応を市場は過小評価している可能性があると指摘した。

ＥＣＢ理事会でタカ派とみられている同氏は「私にとって、問題は追加対応が必要かどうかではなく、あとどれだけ必要かに移りつつある」と述べた。「市場は依然として必要な対応を過小評価している可能性がある。問題は１回の会合や措置ではない。インフレ率を目標に戻し、その水準を保つために必要な道筋だ」と語った。

金融市場は現在、ＥＣＢが今後１年間に２─３回利上げし、その後は緩やかな利下げに転じると見込んでいる。

ＥＣＢは１０月２９日の理事会で金利を据え置いた。インフレの２次的影響がまだ定着しておらず、賃金の伸びも抑えられている上、長期金利の急上昇が経済成長を下押しする可能性が高いとの判断に基づく。

しかしカジミール氏は、こうした要因は一部で考えられているほど安心材料になるとは限らないとの見方を示した。

企業がコストを価格に転嫁する前にコスト上昇圧力が蓄積し、物価上昇圧力の広がりがデータに表れる前にインフレ期待が変化する可能性があると述べた。「確実になるまで待つことが必ずしも良い政策につながるわけではない」と語った。

コスト上昇圧力は既に数カ月にわたって蓄積しているため、成長が鈍化してもインフレが必ずしも弱まるとは限らないと説明した。

各国政府の財政支出が経済への打撃を和らげているため成長は比較的堅調であり、財政規律の欠如も物価上昇圧力を高止まりさせる可能性があると述べた。

「先週の据え置きで対応が終わったわけではない。高インフレが当たり前と感じられるようになる前に行動すべきだ」と訴えた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 11/2(月) 19:40 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

ROME: Italians on Monday (Nov 2) celebrated the success of Kimi Antonelli, who became Formula 1's youngest world champion at the age of 20 when he clinched the title in Mexico City. Antonelli, who is from the northern city of Bologna, is also the first Italian champion since 1953. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni took to social media to praise what she called an "extraordinary achievement". "A success that puts an Italian driver back on top of the world, rewarding talent, commitment, determination and dedication," Meloni said.

"It's a source of great pride for our country," she wrote on X, alongside a picture of Antonelli holding the Italian flag. La Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper ran the headline "Kimitico", a play on words meaning "Legendary Kimi". La Stampa newspaper struck a similar tone, with its headline "Kimi nella leggenda" ("Kimi makes history.")  In Rome, locals took delight in an Italian sporting success, with one comparing Antonelli to tennis champion Jannik Sinner. "They're two shining stars of Italian sport," said Daniela Bulgarini. "He seems like a good kid, very talented. Talent and hard work always pay off."

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli celebrates with an Italian flag on the podium after finishing third in the Mexico City Grand Prix and clinching the 2026 Formula 1 World Championship. (Photo: Reuters/Eloisa Sanchez)

DESTINED FOR THE TOP Antonelli, who drives for Mercedes, is the son of a sports car racing father who took him to the track as a young boy. He was taken on by Mercedes as an 11-year-old karter when his potential as a Formula 1 driver was apparent. "After such a long time without an Italian winning, whether with Ferrari or with other teams, other constructors, it's certainly a great thing," said Giovanni, a worker in Rome. Several hundred fans watched a screening of the grand prix late on Sunday at the Checco Costa Museum at the Imola F1 race track. Although Imola is the home track of the Ferrari team, fans put that allegiance to one side to cheer for Antonelli whose third-place finish in Mexico was enough to seal the title. Another watch-party was held in a cinema in Bologna. The local Serie A soccer club joined in the celebrations, with a post on X reading "The whole of Bologna is proud of you".

item.title: ウクライナ軍、ロシアが局地停戦中に態勢強化と主張 攻撃激化も
item.description: ［キーウ ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［キーウ　２日　ロイター］ - ウクライナ軍参謀本部は２日、ロシアが南部ヘルソン州オレシュキの人道目的の停戦期間中に軍事拠点を強化していたと指摘した。

６日間の局地停戦は、１日２１００ＧＭＴ（日本時間２日午前６時）に終了した。停戦を仲介したトランプ米大統領の妻メラニアさんによると、８００人近くが避難した。

しかしウクライナ軍参謀本部は、ロシア軍の部隊交代、拠点の要塞（ようさい）化、道路沿いでの対ドローン（無人機）対策の拡大、弾薬輸送を含む補給活動の活発化が確認されたと指摘した。

Ｘへの投稿で「ウクライナ軍部隊は停戦順守に努め、合意された枠組みの範囲内でのみ行動した」とした上で、「これに対し敵は、人道的な戦闘休止を利用して自らの陣地を強化した」と指摘した。

ウクライナ海兵隊第３４独立旅団「ボリスフェン」はフェイスブックの動画演説で、ロシアが「戦力を整えて強化するために停戦を利用した」と主張。ロシアの攻撃激化を想定する根拠があるとして、空襲警報を無視しないようヘルソン州の住民に呼びかけた。

ヘルソン市軍政局は、ドニプロ川西側のウクライナ支配地域に位置しオレシュキの対岸にあるヘルソン市の中心部で２日、ドローン攻撃があったと発表した。死傷者は報告されていない。

ヘルソン州知事はテレグラムで、２日０４００ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後１時）までの２４時間に、州都ヘルソンを含む州内のウクライナ支配地域にある１６の集落に対し、ロシア軍が砲撃やドローン、軍用機による攻撃を行ったと明らかにした。

FAST

Nov 2 : SpaceX is in talks to buy EchoStar's wireless service Boost Mobile or gain access to its network, which it leases from AT&T and T-mobile, the Washington Post reported on Monday. SpaceX has held talks with telecom firm EchoStar in recent months about launching its own signature wireless service through a deal with the company, the report said, citing people familiar with the negotiations. The move would support the Elon Musk-led company's plans to build a hybrid satellite-terrestrial mobile network through Starlink Mobile, combining its satellite constellation with ground-based infrastructure to challenge US wireless giants AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile. Telecom stocks came under pressure following SpaceX's $8 billion spectrum deal, as investors assessed the threat posed by a new satellite-powered wireless competitor.

Acquiring Boost Mobile or accessing its network could give SpaceX a ready-made subscriber base and distribution platform to accelerate its plans. EchoStar had 7.38 million wireless subscribers at the end of the second quarter, primarily consisting of Boost Mobile and Gen Mobile customers. Musk has discussed the deal personally, meeting with EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen last month, the Washington Post's report said. The proposed service may need consent from AT&T and T-Mobile, as Boost Mobile's existing network-leasing agreements may not be transferable to a new owner without the carriers' approval, the report said. SpaceX and EchoStar did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. EchoStar shares rose about 3.4 per cent in premarket trading, while T-Mobile slipped 2 per cent. AT&T and Verizon also edged lower. Analysts and industry experts have pointed to the challenges SpaceX might face in building a network that could become the fourth-largest wireless carrier in the US. The rocket and satellite company will likely need to invest heavily in ground infrastructure, customer service, handset subsidies and promotions — costly areas of the wireless business where the Big Three already have extensive operations.

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 2 : US midterm elections don't typically produce market fireworks. Yet the results of November 3's contests could add to investor concerns about AI spending and debt ceiling negotiations, and they may have implications for Corporate America if Democrats put companies under the microscope.  Since Donald Trump returned to the White House in 2025 with full Republican control of Congress, the S&P 500 has gained about 27 per cent, benefiting from vast capital spending on AI and strong earnings growth. However, Treasury yields are also substantially higher, particularly after the US and Israel attacked Iran in February, setting off a surge in energy prices that is now seeping into other parts of the US economy. Investors are trying to gauge how the election results will shape the market outlook. Current forecasts point to Democrats winning the House, with control of the Senate less clear. Since 1930, there have been eight midterm cycles when the president's party lost control of the House, and the S&P 500 rose for the remainder of the year five times, Ned Davis Research said. It posted a median gain of 1.4 per cent from Election Day through year-end, slightly less than the 1.9 per cent posted across all post-Election Day midterm years.

If Democrats win both chambers, investors expect tougher oversight of AI, which could weigh on markets. Democrats would have the ability to investigate Corporate America while trying to slow deregulation, which could add to market volatility.  If Democrats win the House but Republicans keep the Senate, the implications for the US fiscal situation would be mixed. Investors say a divided Congress raises the risk of government shutdowns and debt-limit brinkmanship. That could add to existing pressure on the US sovereign rating, where investors are already concerned about large deficits and rising interest costs. Some strategists warn that spending trade-offs on defense and subsidies for healthcare could widen deficits down the line. The dollar could be dragged lower if the market believes that such policy wrangling may weigh on growth. In a Republican sweep, investors expect the White House could pursue more tax reform or boost defense spending, worsening an already large deficit. The risk of new AI regulation and congressional probes would, however, be low. SPLIT CONGRESS OR DEMOCRATIC SWEEP The biggest effect of a strong Democratic showing could be on the AI trade, where investigations could add momentum to growing public opposition to data centers. Probes could speed up efforts to require safety standards for frontier AI models, independent evaluations and incident reporting, and to hold data center developers more accountable, Raymond James Washington policy analyst Ed Mills said in a note. Investors have banked on an optimistic outlook for AI expansion, and any doubt about its rapid growth causes sharp market moves. Just one in three Americans approve of the fast pace of data-center construction, according to a Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll. A Democratic win in one or both chambers of Congress would give the party powerful tools to probe industries and regulators. Democrats are already preparing to investigate Trump's and his family's ties to the crypto and prediction market industries, Reuters recently reported. Negotiations between a Democratic-held Congress and the White House would likely be confined to must-pass items such as the budget and the debt ceiling, which is expected to come to the fore in 2027, said Diego Barnuevo, market analyst at Ebury. "We think that a Democratic sweep would be neutral to mildly positive for the fiscal outlook," said Barnuevo. Others, however, are skeptical that Democrats would be significantly more restrained, and are similarly pessimistic that any political outcome will materially improve the deteriorating fiscal picture. Ned Davis chief US strategist Ed Clissold said a House takeover by Democrats could modestly temper the US equity market's year-end rally, but in general it has not prevented stocks from advancing. "Conventional wisdom is that gridlock is good (for stocks)," said Clissold, adding stocks have performed better under Democratic presidents than Republicans. REPUBLICAN SWEEP A Republican sweep could have more dramatic implications for Treasuries, as it would continue policy that could further expand the deficit. "If that were to happen, it would validate a lot of the policy agenda that Trump and (US Treasury Secretary Scott) Bessent have undergone on the fiscal side," said Joaquín Kritz Lara, chief economist and strategist at Numera Analytics. The Trump administration might then lean toward more tax reform or a significant expansion of the defense budget, potentially worsening the US fiscal position, he said. For the dollar, higher Treasury yields might help initially. "A clean Republican hold might initially support the dollar through the yield channel, but would also be read as a green light for more deficit-financed policy, continued pressure on institutions, and further foreign adventurism — factors that could force investors to raise hedge ratios over longer time frames," Karl Schamotta, chief market strategist with payments company Corpay in Toronto, said. A strong Republican showing would ease concerns over investigations into AI companies. "If Republicans maintain control of Congress, that would likely provide the most supportive incremental federal policy backdrop for the AI/Infrastructure buildout through policy continuity, potential fiscal expansion, deregulation and faster federal permitting," JPMorgan strategists said in a note.

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 2 : A steep decline in the prices of US AI and technology stocks is testing investors' enthusiasm to shift into other equity areas, a rotation that has propped up broader indexes in recent weeks.  Disappointing results from Alphabet, Amazon and Intel dealt the latest blow to the AI trade. Investors worry about the hefty financing needed to fund massive investment spending. They are also starting to question whether returns will be robust enough to justify that spending.  The broader market in October held up far better than tech- and AI-exposed equities did, but it may not be able to endure a more severe pullback in the massive AI trade. The tech sector alone accounts for a 38 per cent weight in the S&P 500. Investors are wary of signs that the selling will spread. A main alarm would be indications that the AI hyperscalers pull back significantly on spending plans. Their investment in data centers and other infrastructure has been a key driver for overall economic growth.

"You can have a month of a significant shift in leadership and tech weakness and relative strength in everything else," said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist for Nationwide. However, "if you have another month of (a steep) drop ... it's so big that mathematically it's difficult, but I think even more importantly, psychologically it's difficult." Friday's action illustrated such worries. A whopping 4.2 per cent drop on the day for the tech sector, which included a nearly 29 per cent tumble for Intel, drove a 1.8 per cent decline for the S&P 500. For October, the S&P 500 tech sector slid 6.8 per cent, its biggest monthly drop since March 2025. Yet nine of the S&P 500's 11 sectors gained in October — allowing the benchmark index to end with a monthly decline of less than 1 per cent. ROTATIONS BETWEEN AI AND EVERYTHING ELSE The S&P 500 is up more than 10 per cent so far in 2026. Yet rotations have been a theme for the past year. Leadership has often vacillated between heavyweight tech and AI stocks on one hand, and a broader group of sectors on the other. September, for example, showed opposite trends to October, with dominance that month from tech and AI stocks. "This year has been unbelievably stable at the index level," Hackett said. "But there's so much volatility beneath the surface." October trading indicated a sign of broadening. Despite sharp declines in AI names, more than 70 per cent of S&P 500 constituents were up on the month. Indexes representing small- and mid-cap stocks also rose in October. "Both corporate and consumer fundamentals remain healthy," said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global investment strategist at Edward Jones. "In this backdrop, investors want to maintain equity exposure. But now they want to reduce AI concentration risk and are adding to areas that offer differentiated sources of return." AI SPENDING IN FOCUS FOR BROADER FALLOUT That desire to maintain equity exposure could be challenged in the near term, if the AI theme falters more severely. AI investment spending has not only driven profits for semiconductors and companies involved in building data centers, it has also been central to overall US economic growth. If big tech companies "start pulling back on capex, which has supported economic growth, it has boosted earnings across many different areas of the economy — that can be something that may be more impactful in terms of driving a broader risk-off sentiment," Kourkafas said. Oxford Economics estimates that about one-third of recent US economic growth stems from AI. That includes the net impact of direct investment to support expansion of AI infrastructure as well as some contribution from the wealth effect from stock market gains that has lifted consumer spending. "The consumer is fine, but the consumer isn't the reason the economy looks good. The economy looks good because of AI," said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at retirement and wealth services provider Empower. "So you start pulling the rug out from under AI in an actual meaningful way, I think that changes the dynamics for the markets." Meanwhile, the market action could start to cause broader worry. The S&P 500 on Friday closed below its 100-day moving average — a medium-term trendline — for the first time since April. While the index has bounced off that trendline several times in the past two years, "when it has broken below ... in any material way, it was followed by a much further drop over the following weeks," said Matthew Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak. "If the major averages begin to drop in a more compelling manner, it is very likely that investors will stop rotating into other sectors ... and start rotating into cash," Maley said in a note on Friday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 独製造業ＰＭＩ改定値、10月は54.2に上昇 輸出が堅調
item.description: [ベルリン ２日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２日発表した１０月のドイツ製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）改定値...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独製造業ＰＭＩ改定値、10月は54.2に上昇　輸出が堅調 11/2 18:52 配信

[ベルリン ２日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが２日発表した１０月のドイツ製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）改定値は５４．２と、９月の５３．９から上昇した。輸出の増加と政府関連の需要が生産と受注を支えた。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済担当アソシエートディレクター、フィル・スミス氏は「コスト上昇圧力が再び強まったにもかかわらず、ドイツ製造業の回復は１０月も順調に続き、底堅さを示した」と述べた。

生産は１０カ月連続で増加したが、伸びは鈍化し７月以来の低水準となった。新規受注の伸びも３カ月ぶりの低水準となった。一方、輸出は堅調に増加し、伸びがやや加速した。

海外需要の強さは直近のピークだった８月に次いで、４年半余りで２番目の高水準となった。企業からはアジアや北米、欧州の一部向けの販売が増えたとの声が聞かれた。

受注残は３カ月連続で増加した。増加ペースは９月と変わらず、２０２２年４月以来の高水準を維持した。雇用はわずかな減少にとどまり、減少幅は２３年８月以来の最小となった。

投入価格を示す指数は５カ月ぶりの高水準となり、仕入れ先からの納入の遅れも５月以来最も深刻になるなど、コスト上昇圧力が強まった。一方、競争圧力で企業の価格決定力が抑えられ、出荷価格の上昇率は８カ月ぶりの低水準に鈍化した。

製造業各社は今後１年間の生産について楽観的な見方を維持したものの、コストの急上昇が重荷となり、景況感は７月以来の低水準に落ち込んだ。納期が長期化する中、購入品の在庫をほぼ４年ぶりに積み増した。

item.title: Oil drops 6% as Iran signals openness to peace talks
item.description: LONDON, Nov 2 : Oil fell about 6 per cent on Monday as talks between Iranian and Qatari officials on ending the US-Israeli war with Iran lifted hopes for reduced Middle East supply disruptions, while Iran's president said the supreme leader had granted the government "certain authorities" regarding peace talks.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Oil drops 6% as Iran signals openness to peace talks

FILE PHOTO: Crude oil storage tanks are seen in an aerial photograph at the Cushing oil hub in Cushing, Oklahoma, U.S. April 21, 2020. REUTERS/Drone Base/File Photo

02 Nov 2026 05:30PM (Updated: 02 Nov 2026 10:37PM)

FAST

LONDON, Nov 2 : Oil fell about 6 per cent on Monday as talks between Iranian and Qatari officials on ending the US-Israeli war with Iran lifted hopes for reduced Middle East supply disruptions, while Iran's president said the supreme leader had granted the government "certain authorities" regarding peace talks. Iranian negotiators held days of talks with Qatari mediators aimed at ending the war with the United States, and a draft proposal is being circulated with a follow-up meeting possible, an official briefed on the talks said on Monday. Brent crude futures fell $6.78, or 6.0 per cent, to $106.65 a barrel by 1357 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude was down $6.37, or 6.1 per cent, at $97.75. The contracts fell as low as $105.86 and $97.12, respectively, after Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei had granted the government certain authorities for peace talks, boosting expectations of a diplomatic breakthrough, analysts said.

Pezeshkian added Tehran "will try to resolve the problem with dialogue", without elaborating, according to state media. Brent ended October at its highest in six months on concerns that the Middle East conflict could escalate again after Tuesday's US midterm elections. "The oil market is still reacting with extreme sensitivity to every headline out of the Middle East," UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo said. "While fears of an imminent escalation pushed prices up last week, they have dropped sharply at the start of this week as diplomatic talks between the US and Iran continue," he added. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday that the purpose of the talks was to continue consultations with the Qatari mediators, adding that Tehran was prepared for "both defence and diplomacy". The talks followed a recent increase in attacks on oil tankers passing the Strait of Hormuz, though there have also been signs of shipments rising from some major exporters. Saudi Arabia's crude exports increased in October compared with September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite attacks by Iran-aligned Yemeni Houthis on its energy infrastructure. The outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February has depleted oil stocks. The world has drained nearly 1 billion barrels from inventories since the war disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, said Sultan Al Jaber, chief executive of ADNOC, Abu Dhabi's state-owned oil company. Oil could rise further, some analysts say. Goldman Sachs raised its price forecasts on Sunday owing to elevated supply risks and said Brent could jump to $140 in 2027 if Gulf oil output remains 3.5 million barrels per day below its 2025 average. "Intensified shipping attacks, damage to oil infrastructure, and a more persistent risk premium remain the key triggers of potential upside," the bank said in a report.

Source: Reuters
